row: Katz Chiropractic and Rehabilitation Clinic & DMX

We are a husband and wife chiropractic team. We have published many papers on the spine and car crashes. We have published in Journal Of Brain Circulation showing how loss of curve decreases BLOOD flow. We also published the largest cervical paper using DMX comparing injured necks to non-injured necks.
